name: Monaco Editor Plugin
description: Monaco code editor with multi-tab editing. Dynamically bootstraps Monaco via AMD require() — shared across instances (monacoReady singleton). Defines custom themes: cockpit-dark (deep noir #0A0E14 bg) and cockpit-light (clean #f8f8f8 bg). Multi-tab support: drag-and-drop reorder, middle-click close, right-click context menu (Close/Close Others/Close All/Copy Path), dirty indicator (unsaved dot). 30+ languages detected from file extension. Auto-save: debounced 1.5s after content change. Ctrl+S action registered via editor.addAction. External file change detection via fs:onChanged — auto-reloads content preserving cursor if unchanged by user. IDE context server integration: debounced 150ms selection_changed events. State serialization: openFiles[], activeFile, cursors (lineNumber, column, scrollTop). Theme-aware: re-applies cockpit-dark/cockpit-light on updateTheme().
